title: Implement paired call-scoped resource borrows
description:

PR501 merged my retained borrow syntax prerequisite; completed generic transfer/guard tasks do not satisfy the remaining borrow semantics contract. I preserve ordinary by-value behavior, same-owner nominal identity, and conservative rejection of unsupported stored/returned/generic callback reference shapes. My dependency order is explicit lexer/parser/schema and retained annotation identity; shared/exclusive call argument ownership and overlap checks; observable backend behavior; paired positive/negative tests across C seed and native Stage1/Stage2; then followup IR ownership representation under existing task_ed70242ac4d83be7b2327da7ece387ad. Required positive cases read twice then consume and mutate through an exclusive call then observe/consume; negatives include consumption/mutation through shared borrow, overlapping exclusive/shared arguments, move during a live argument borrow, use after move, escaping/storing references and mismatched annotations. I must not implement exclusive mutation as an invisible value copy. If a prerequisite must land separately, it remains explicitly partial and does not close this task or the full acceptance parent. Root coordinates other active files; publication hold stays.
